compliance_flags.rule: Policy 205: do not dump price in the first 2 minutes without explaining Bar-Model vs rote tuition
compliance_flags.quote: So let me quickly tell you our fee structure for Dubai students.
the discount link expires in 30 minutes because batch seats fill very fast in Dubai
Building tuition is just old-fashioned rote learning where many kids sit together.

strengths.text: You named fractions, decimals and word problems and mentioned Zing quizzes and monthly reports, so the parent heard that the program covers her concern.
The discount you offered was within the cap and calculated correctly.

fixes.text: Ask and explain before quoting. The demo educator already recorded the answer to this parent's question.
fixes.better_line: Before fees, let me share what Mr. Vikram saw: Zoya solved two British-curriculum fraction word problems on her own with our Bar-Model drawing method.

fixes.text: Remove the deadline. When a parent says she is comparing, give her information, not a clock.
fixes.better_line: Take your time. I'll send you a short sample of how the Bar-Model works so you can compare it with her tutor's worksheets.

coaching.next_call_drill: Open the evaluation sheet before every call and read the 'magic moment' and 'learning gap' aloud to yourself.
